panels.title: Billed by Google (Cloud Billing export; a few hours behind, in the billing account's currency)
Billed this month
panels.description: This project's invoice so far this month, after credits (free tier, promotions).

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(net_cost) AS billed FROM billing_export.costs WHERE invoice_month = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', CURRENT_DATE())
SELECT SUM(net_cost) AS billed FROM billing_export.costs WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

panels.title: Credits in range
panels.description: Negative: what the free tier and promotions took off.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(credits) AS credits FROM billing_export.costs WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
SELECT ANY_VALUE(currency) AS currency FROM billing_export.costs
SELECT service, ROUND(SUM(net_cost), 4) AS cost FROM billing_export.costs WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY service ORDER BY cost DESC
SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(time, DAY) AS time, service, SUM(net_cost) AS cost FROM billing_export.costs WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT service, sku, ROUND(SUM(cost), 4) AS cost, ROUND(SUM(credits), 4) AS credits, ROUND(SUM(net_cost), 4) AS net FROM billing_export.costs WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY service, sku ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Live estimates (selected range, defaults to this month)
Total (estimate)
panels.description: Claude + GKE pods + Pub/Sub at list price, before credits. Leaves out the load balancer and the cluster fee; the billed row above has them.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(llm_cost_usd_total[$__range]))) or vector(0)) + ((sum (sum_over_time(kubernetes_io:container_cpu_request_cores{monitored_resource="k8s_container",namespace_name=~"api|doc-worker|detection-worker|case-worker|audit-metrics|gateway|frontend|observability"}[$__range])) / 60 * $cpu_price + sum (sum_over_time(kubernetes_io:container_memory_request_bytes{monitored_resource="k8s_container",namespace_name=~"api|doc-worker|detection-worker|case-worker|audit-metrics|gateway|frontend|observability"}[$__range])) / 60 / 1073741824 * $mem_price) or vector(0)) + ((sum(increase(pubsub_googleapis_com:topic_byte_cost[$__range]))) or vector(0)) / 1099511627776 * $pubsub_price

options.content: Estimates at list price, before credits and taxes, live within minutes. **Billed cost** is the top row, from Cloud Billing's export (hours behind; empty until the export is turned on, see deploy/terraform/README.md). Claude isn't billed by Google, so its cost is always the app's own count, from each call's tokens and `backend/app/pricing.py`. The GKE prices are Autopilot's **asia-southeast1** list prices, approximate: check Google's pricing page and edit the boxes at the top if they differ.

panels.title: Per case (range): GKE from the billing export, by namespace (cost allocation, gke.tf)
Cloud cost per case analysed
panels.description: Everything Google billed in the range (the cluster, load balancer, Pub/Sub...) over the case analyses that finished in it. The cluster costs money idle, so few cases make each one look expensive.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(net_cost) AS billed FROM billing_export.costs WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

panels.title: Claude cost per case analysed
panels.description: Every Claude call in the range (documents, detection and analyses) over the case analyses that finished in it.

panels.title: Cluster billed in range
panels.description: Lines GKE's cost allocation labelled with a namespace; the cluster's own fee and idle capacity have none.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(net_cost) AS billed FROM billing_export.costs WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND namespace IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Billed by namespace (range)
panels.description: Each service's share of the cluster: the api, each worker, the gateway, Grafana.

targets.rawSql: SELECT namespace, ROUND(SUM(net_cost), 4) AS cost FROM billing_export.costs WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND namespace IS NOT NULL GROUP BY namespace ORDER BY cost DESC
